findings.title: Semantic Trading: Agentic AI for Clustering
findings.reason: Focuses on same-outcome/different-outcome market relationships via semantic clustering. Novel angle on pair selection but no quantitative results matching our gate. Not staged.

findings.title: Attention Factors for Statistical Arbitrage (Epstein, Wang, Choi, Pelger; ACM ICAIF 2025)
findings.reason: OOS Sharpe > 4.0 on US large-cap equities over 24 years. Net of transaction costs: 2.3. 84% improvement over SOTA. Conditional latent factors via attention over firm characteristics. Industry-sector-aligned factors. STAGED as H347 proposal.

angles.query: PEAD + post-earnings drift + text signals + LLM

findings.title: Enhancing PEAD Measurement with LLMs
findings.reason: FinBERT + LLM ensemble achieves 57.6-58.3% directional accuracy on earnings-day PEAD. Directly upgrades H174 confirmed pipeline (score >= 0.18 + surprise >= 0.02, WR=81.8%). STAGED as H348 proposal.

findings.title: FinAnchor: Multi-Modal Aligned Representations for Financial Prediction
findings.reason: Multi-modal (text + price + volume) aligned representation learning for financial prediction. Potentially useful for H174/H348 upgrade but requires significant ML infrastructure. Not staged — lower priority than H348.

findings.title: HiFi-KPI: Hierarchical KPI Extraction from Earnings Filings
findings.reason: Structured KPI extraction (revenue growth, margin trends) from 10-K/10-Q filings. H174 feature engineering potential. Not staged — FMP API coverage is the primary constraint for H174, not KPI extraction methodology.

findings.title: Multi-Modal Deep Learning for Earnings Day Direction Prediction
findings.reason: Already referenced in wiki as H317. No new information.

angles.query: cross-sectional momentum + factor momentum + ML enhancement

findings.title: Deep Learning for Cross-Sectional Momentum on Chinese A-Shares
findings.reason: Chinese A-share market specific. Different regulatory regime (daily price-move limits), different market structure. Not applicable to H198 US large-cap universe.

findings.title: ML Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization with Bias Correction (Yimin Du, 2025)
findings.reason: Identifies 'upstream contamination' bug specific to Chinese A-share daily price limits — not applicable to US equities where this limit structure doesn't exist. The 0.44 Sharpe improvement is from fixing a China-specific data quality bug, not from a portable methodology. Has GitHub repo: initial-d/ml-quant-trading. Not staged for hypothesis but noted as code quality reference.

angles.query: arXiv multi-agent LLM trading systems portfolio optimization 2025 2026

findings.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
findings.reason: Japanese stock market focus. Fine-grained task decomposition (fundamental analysis, sentiment, valuation agents) improves risk-adjusted returns. Not staged — Japanese market structure limits US applicability; H318 (meta-agent ETF rotation selector) already covers this design space.

findings.title: Toward Reliable Evaluation of LLM-Based Financial Multi-Agent Systems
findings.reason: Meta-paper: taxonomy + evaluation framework for LLM financial agents. References BlackRock AlphaAgents (arXiv:2508.11152). Useful reference for H318 design. Not staged — informational, not actionable hypothesis.

findings.title: MadEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization of Trading Systems with Large Language Models
findings.reason: Multi-agent evolutionary architecture for equity portfolio construction. Overlaps significantly with QuantaAlpha (arXiv:2602.07085) which was staged. Not staged separately.

findings.title: QuantaAlpha: An Evolutionary Framework for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining
findings.reason: Open-source (GitHub: QuantaAlpha/QuantaAlpha). IC=0.1501 on CSI300 with GPT-5.2, ARR=27.75%, MDD=7.98%. S&P500 transfer: 137% cumulative excess return over 4 years. Evolutionary trajectory-level mutation/crossover. Directly usable as hypothesis GENERATION tool for H350+ using our existing H198 universe and yfinance cached data. STAGED as H349 proposal.

findings.title: AlphaForgeBench: Benchmarking End-to-End Trading Strategy Design with Large Language Models
findings.reason: Benchmark suite for evaluating LLM trading strategy design end-to-end. Useful for comparing H349 QuantaAlpha output quality. Reference only — not staged.

summary.key_insight: Two high-signal directions from this scan: (1) Conditional latent factor models (Attention Factors, arXiv:2510.11616) achieve OOS Sharpe > 4 on US large-caps with an interpretable sector-structure — the strongest pure-quant result in the scan. (2) LLM-driven alpha mining via evolutionary search (QuantaAlpha) now has an open-source tool with S&P500 transfer validation — lowers the cost of hypothesis generation for H350+. PEAD LLM enhancement (H348) is the lowest-risk extension given H174 is already confirmed with 81.8% WR.
